description: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC): road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in datos.gob.es, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). Coverage: Instituto Canario de Estadística (ISTAC). The listing groups 18 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Clasificación del tipos de accidentes de la Dirección General de Tráfi; Actividad registrada por problemas con vehículos/tráfico según tipos, ; Entrada de pasajeros desde el extranjero según clases de tráfico por a; Clasificación de la condición del firme de la Dirección General de Trá. Formats seen: CSV, JSON, PC-AXIS, XML, SHEET. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (http://www.gobiernodecanarias.org/istac/aviso_legal.html). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-datos-gob-es.
